name: app-problem-and-solution-timeline-with-photos-and-blue-bars
title: Problem and Solution Blue Timeline
whatItIs: A pale slide with a numbered Problem & Solution pill, a red Problem heading, three image tiles (phone, chat prompt with a curly arrow, medical photo), a blue Solution heading and a vertical blue bar timeline with three paragraphs alternating sides.
whatItMeans: The red-to-blue shift shows the move from problem to solution, and the timeline bars keep the reading order clear.
techniques: Red dot for problem, blue dot for solution
Hand-drawn curly arrow linking image to statement
Vertical blue bar with side dots
Bold key words in a light headline

vocabulary.definition: Using colour to signal meaning, like red for problem.
A line with points and text alternating along it.
A sketchy arrow adding informal direction.
